units.source_text: 大竹七段虽然同意续弈，也彻夜未眠，苦恼已极。

en.t: Although Otake 7-dan agreed to resume the game, he too lay awake all night, tormented to the extreme.

units.source_text: 黎明时分，约莫五六点钟光景，他便在旅馆走廊上来回踱步。

en.t: At dawn, around five or six o'clock, he began pacing back and forth along the hotel corridor.

units.source_text: 一大早便穿好带家徽的礼服，怏怏不乐地躺在正门大厅的长椅上。

en.t: Early in the morning, already dressed in formal clothes bearing his family crest, he lay dejectedly on a bench in the front hall.
